name: Dragon Emperor Monarch

passive.name: Monarch of Destruction
passive.desc: Antares' dragon fear: every enemy card starts with -25% damage, his breath burns the whole enemy deck (burning for 3 turns) and hits the whole bench for 45%, he takes 30% less damage and finishes enemies under 20% HP (not bosses).

tierNote: Weakens, burns and hits the whole enemy deck: the best team card. Mid stats and a loss to Beast Emperor keep it at A.
strengths: Whole enemy deck deals 25% less damage from the start
Burns the whole enemy deck and hits the bench for 45%
weaknesses: Loses 1-on-1 to Beast Emperor: its undying passive survives the execute
Lower base stats than Beast Emperor
notes: Best opener: its fear, burn and bench hit weaken every enemy card before the rest of the team fights.

name: Moon Eye Ghost

passive.name: Infinite Tsukuyomi
passive.desc: Madara casts the Infinite Tsukuyomi on the whole enemy deck when the fight starts (every enemy card -20% damage), Limbo clones hit 2x, his Perfect Susanoo hits the whole bench for 40% and blocks 3 hits, and he revives once with 50% HP.

tierNote: A deck-wide -20% debuff, 2x clone hits and a revive help any team, but the lowest ATK and HP lose too many 1-on-1s.
strengths: Whole enemy deck deals 20% less damage
Blocks 3 hits and revives once at 50% HP
Perfect Susanoo hits the whole bench for 40%
weaknesses: Lowest base ATK and HP of the current cards
Damage-reduction tanks cut both of its hits
Ignore-defense attacks skip its Susanoo blocks
notes: Stack its -20% with Dragon Emperor Monarch's -25%: enemies then deal only 60% damage.

name: Atomic Shadow Lord

passive.name: I AM ATOMIC
passive.desc: Cid Kagenou, the Eminence in Shadow: his first hit on every new enemy does 3x and blows through the whole enemy bench for 40%, ignores every defense, he dodges 30%, and the whole Shadow Garden gets +25% damage and HP.

tierNote: A 3x opening hit and Shadow Garden buffs, but below-average stats and the worst matchups in the library drag it to C.
strengths: First hit on every new enemy does 3x
Blows through the whole enemy bench for 40%
Ignores every defense (damage reduction and blocks)
weaknesses: Lowest HP after Moon Eye Ghost: falls fast in long fights
The 3x only works once per enemy, so it is weak against bosses
Shadow Garden +25% does nothing yet (no other Shadow Garden cards)
notes: Cleaner: put it after the openers so its 3x hits finish cards that are already burned and splashed. Rank goes up if Shadow Garden cards are added.

name: Beast Emperor

passive.name: Strongest Creature
passive.desc: Kaido can't die: he survives the first killing blow at 1 HP, takes 30% less damage, can't be stunned or frozen, and his Thunder Bagua does 2.5x every 3rd attack. He gets stronger every time he is hit (+6% damage per hit).

tierNote: Top ATK and HP plus a passive that can't die win the most 1-on-1s. Only average team value keeps it below SS.
strengths: Highest ATK and HP of the current cards
Survives the first killing blow at 1 HP
Takes 30% less damage and cannot be stunned or frozen
Gets +6% damage every time it is hit; 2.5x every 3rd attack
weaknesses: No team effect: only helps itself
Ignore-defense attacks skip its 30% damage reduction
No AoE: kills one enemy at a time
notes: Wins every 1-on-1 among the current cards. Best as the anchor at the back: it cannot die the first time and keeps getting stronger.
